_comment: Background removal on the user's ComfyUI with Lucida (a BiRefNet_HR fine-tune; in its author's 203-image benchmark the strongest open model overall, and on glow/VFX, illustration, text and camouflage), ComfyUI's native nodes (0.38+): the subject on a transparent background (PNG with alpha). RemoveBackground's mask is the foreground and ComfyUI's alpha masks are inverted, so it is inverted before JoinImageWithAlpha, as in Comfy-Org's Remove Background template. Weights: background_removal/lucida_v7.safetensors, the author's current release (egeorcun/lucida model.safetensors, v7; Comfy-Org/BiRefNet's lucida.safetensors is an earlier one), fetched by helm/comfyui in the homelab repo. Works on glow art on black too; see docs/art.md.

_meta.vram_note: ComfyUI's peak on the 5090 for a 1536 px image (the model runs at 1024 px; the card lost 1.0 GiB of free VRAM), measured 2026-10-09
_meta.seconds_note: a 1536 px image on the 5090, the model loaded cold
